basic_profile.bio: I'm a science student at the University of Waterloo, currently navigating my way through the co-op program. I enjoy hiking and exploring local parks around Waterloo, and I'm passionate about ecological conservation. I often spend my evenings online, especially after a long day of studying or attending online classes. I'm single and enjoy spending time with friends, both virtually and in person, when possible. I occasionally participate in local community events and have recently become interested in digital art.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: As a science student, my knowledge is centered around biology and environmental science. I've acquired a lot of this through coursework at the University of Waterloo, and I also engage in self-study through online resources and scientific journals. I'm particularly interested in how ecological systems function and the impact of human activities on the environment.
